The transfer operating threshold is the transfer adjustment factor * $7 820.59 + an uncompensated DSH payment of $71 888.02. If operating cost exceeds the transfer operating threshold  add-ons for qualifying new technology services are included. If operating cost exceeds the transfer operating threshold + the cost of any qualifying new technology services  the stay qualifies for a transfer operating outlier of 80% of the excess amount. The base transfer capital payment is the transfer adjustment factor * $201.31. The transfer capital threshold is the transfer adjustment factor * $201.31. If the capital cost exceeds the transfer capital threshold  the stay qualifies for a transfer capital outlier of 80% of the excess amount. Reimbursement is multiplied by 99% as per the Hospital Acquired Conditions (HAC) program. Final payment is multiplied by 105%. Includes an add-on of 32% of RC 0278.
